stimulus: Monira said to Protiva How does the question seem to you Have you got everything common. No one item is uncommon to me. What about you said protiva. Im in the same position like you replied Monira. Part B : Composition (20 Marks)
guide_solution: Monira said to Provita, “How does the question seem to you? Have you got everything common?” “No, one item is uncommon to me. What about you?” said Provita. “I’m in the same position like you”, replied Monira.
